name: mlkem
description: ML-KEM-768 (FIPS 203) for TLS's X25519MLKEM768: key generation from a 64-byte seed, encapsulation with the modulus check, decapsulation with implicit rejection, constant time over secrets; its own Keccak (SHA3-256, SHA3-512, SHAKE128, SHAKE256); keys generated in place from random's seed, encapsulation from random's seed, a SharedSecret only a key derivation takes, secrets wiped.
